title: Path A One Click (Two Minutes Flat)
style: decision tree anthem, 100 bpm, ops menu rap, three path flow, drum and bass undertone, click pulse, deadpan choice, dashboard core, terminal serenity
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Path A fastest one click two minutes
CF Dashboard Pages pelican project visits
Direct Upload UI from desktop zynthio tools
Index dot HTML lands the live rules

[Pre-Chorus]
No token regen no certbot no DNS swap
Just drag and drop from the build folder lap

[Chorus]
Path A path A one click is the way
Two minutes flat and the site sees day
Direct Upload UI on the Pages project tab
Seconds later live no API grab

[Verse 2]
Path B fix the token five minutes regen
Thirty six sites unlock from the same env then
Wrangler pages deploy from var dub dub dub
Curl ten thousand bytes confirms the stub

[Bridge]
Path C keep DNS at VDS ten minutes work
Certbot nginx HTTPS at the origin lurk

[Outro]
Path A path A one click flip
Two minutes from build to ship
